Asset credits

Gold coin

This work is based on Mantis Flip Coin by madmachabre (listed as winterstalons on Sketchfab), licensed under CC BY 4.0.

The supplied model's mesh and PBR textures are used for 3D coin pickups. Textures were resized for mobile; the model was centred, made upright, scaled for gameplay, and packaged as GLB. In the game, the cartoon outline is hidden and the material uses studio reflections and colour-preserving shadow fill.

Original attribution supplied with the model
